text.Mr.Video 是扎根缅甸的新媒体全链路服务商，由中缅资深团队操盘，业务覆盖企: Mr.Video is a full-service new media agency rooted in Myanmar, operated by a senior China-Myanmar team. We cover corporate promotion, social media management, new media talent training, short-video e-commerce, omni-channel precision targeting and influencer incubation — providing end-to-end support from strategy, shooting and editing through to media buying and talent development. Guided by our philosophy of "only creating traffic that brings value", we pair proven traffic playbooks with the realities of the Myanmar market to empower local businesses and brands, turning traffic into visible business growth and lasting brand equity.
